title.en: Types of movement and types of muscle

hook.en: When you blink, your eyelid moves but you stay where you are. When you walk to the canteen, you change place. Every locomotion is a movement, but is every movement a locomotion?
hook.kn: ಕಣ್ಣು ಮಿಟುಕಿಸಿದಾಗ ರೆಪ್ಪೆ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ನೀವು ಅಲ್ಲೇ ಇರುತ್ತೀರಿ. ಕ್ಯಾಂಟೀನ್‌ಗೆ ನಡೆದಾಗ ಸ್ಥಳ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಸ್ಥಾನಾಂತರ ಚಲನೆಯೂ ಚಲನೆಯೇ, ಆದರೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಚಲನೆಯೂ ಸ್ಥಾನಾಂತರ ಚಲನೆಯೇ?

objectives.en: Describe amoeboid, ciliary and muscular movement
Compare skeletal, visceral and cardiac muscle

narration.en: When you blink, your eyelid moves but you stay where you are. When you walk to the canteen, you change place. Every locomotion is a movement, but is every movement a locomotion?
narration.kn: ಕಣ್ಣು ಮಿಟುಕಿಸಿದಾಗ ರೆಪ್ಪೆ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ನೀವು ಅಲ್ಲೇ ಇರುತ್ತೀರಿ. ಕ್ಯಾಂಟೀನ್‌ಗೆ ನಡೆದಾಗ ಸ್ಥಳ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಸ್ಥಾನಾಂತರ ಚಲನೆಯೂ ಚಲನೆಯೇ, ಆದರೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಚಲನೆಯೂ ಸ್ಥಾನಾಂತರ ಚಲನೆಯೇ?

body.en: Movement is a significant feature of living beings; voluntary movements that result in a change of place are called locomotion. Human cells show three main types of movement. Amoeboid movement is seen in specialised cells such as macrophages and leucocytes in blood; pseudopodia are formed by streaming of protoplasm, as in Amoeba, and cytoskeletal elements such as microfilaments are involved. Ciliary movement occurs in internal tubular organs lined by ciliated epithelium: coordinated movement of cilia in the trachea removes dust particles and foreign substances, and passage of ova through the female reproductive tract is also helped by it. Muscular movement of the limbs, jaws and tongue needs muscles.
body.kn: ಸ್ಥಳ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಗುವ ಐಚ್ಛಿಕ ಚಲನೆಯೇ ಸ್ಥಾನಾಂತರ ಚಲನೆ. ಮ್ಯಾಕ್ರೋಫೇಜ್ ಮತ್ತು ಬಿಳಿ ರಕ್ತಕಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅಮೀಬಾಯ್ಡ್ ಚಲನೆ, ಶ್ವಾಸನಾಳ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂಡನಾಳಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ರೋಮಕ ಚಲನೆ, ಕೈಕಾಲು, ದವಡೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಾಲಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ನಾಯು ಚಲನೆ ಕಂಡುಬರುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: The teacher draws amoeboid, ciliary and muscular movement and compares the three kinds of muscle in a table.

say.en: Human cells move in three ways: amoeboid, ciliary and muscular.
Amoeboid movement uses pseudopodia, ciliary movement sweeps dust or ova along tubes, and muscular movement moves limbs, jaws and tongue.
Muscle is about 40 to 50 percent of our body weight. Compare the three kinds.
Cardiac muscle is striated like skeletal muscle but involuntary like visceral muscle.

body.en: Muscle is a specialised tissue of mesodermal origin; about 40–50 per cent of the body weight of a human adult is muscle. Skeletal muscles are attached to bones, look striated (striped) and are under voluntary control; they are mainly responsible for locomotion and changes of body posture. Visceral muscles lie in the inner walls of hollow visceral organs such as the alimentary canal and reproductive tract; they are smooth (non-striated) and involuntary, and move food along the digestive tract and gametes through the genital tract. Cardiac muscle is the muscle of the heart: many cardiac muscle cells assemble in a branching pattern, it is striated and involuntary.
body.kn: ಸ್ನಾಯು ಮಧ್ಯಪದರದಿಂದ ಹುಟ್ಟಿದ ವಿಶೇಷ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ; ವಯಸ್ಕರ ದೇಹದ ತೂಕದ 40–50% ಸ್ನಾಯು. ಅಸ್ಥಿಪಂಜರ ಸ್ನಾಯುಗಳು ಪಟ್ಟೆಯುಳ್ಳ ಮತ್ತು ಐಚ್ಛಿಕ; ಒಳಾಂಗ ಸ್ನಾಯುಗಳು ನಯವಾದ ಮತ್ತು ಅನೈಚ್ಛಿಕ; ಹೃದಯ ಸ್ನಾಯು ಪಟ್ಟೆಯುಳ್ಳ, ಕವಲೊಡೆದ ಮತ್ತು ಅನೈಚ್ಛಿಕ.

problem.en: Classify each movement as amoeboid, ciliary or muscular: (a) a WBC squeezing out of a capillary to reach an infection, (b) dust being moved up the windpipe, (c) chewing a chapati, (d) an ovum moving along the oviduct.

steps.en: (a) The WBC forms pseudopodia by protoplasmic streaming — amoeboid.
(b) Cilia lining the trachea beat in coordination — ciliary.
(c) Jaw movement needs skeletal muscles — muscular.
(d) Passage of the ovum is helped by cilia of the female reproductive tract — ciliary.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Classify each movement as amoeboid, ciliary or muscular: (a) a WBC squeezing out of a capillary to reach an infection, (b) dust being moved up the windpipe, (c) chewing a chapati, (d) an ovum moving along the oviduct.

body.en: Cardiac muscle mixes the other two: it is striated like skeletal muscle and involuntary like visceral muscle.

narration.en: Which muscle is "both"?. Cardiac muscle mixes the other two: it is striated like skeletal muscle and involuntary like visceral muscle.
